# ADR-3242: AWS s3: S3 Block Public Access required key for account 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Per-bucket mistakes still happen without account BPA.

## Decision

Accounts MUST set an S3 Block Public Access required key for account 2 (AWS-s3-2).

## Consequences

Exceptions are rare and ticketed.
